what_happened: All six territory-edge/dependency tasks (362, 394, 395, 425, 428, 494) were already landed and archived by the time this research phase ran, including the sibling chokepoint record (394) whose speculative 'refusal' framing in the dispatch description turned out, on reading its actual landed summary, to be a second redundant drop-and-warn gate rather than a refusal -- resolving the dispatch's own flagged reconciliation-ordering concern with zero new work needed.

Plan-time re-derivation found an input the research report did not name: test-update-task-status.sh Case 11h actively PINS the rejection of --file-scope-add on postflight/implement, including an assertion on the literal error text 'target_status in {research, plan}'. Widening the gate therefore requires inverting an existing passing test case, not only adding a new one -- caught before implement rather than as a surprise red suite.
